reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Standard and custom reports built from the system's data. Each user sees only what their role allows.
reports.empty: There are no reports available yet
reports.empty_hint: Create your own with the “New report” button.
reports.none_mine: You haven't created any reports yet. Only you can see private reports.
reports.g_mine_hint: Private: only you can see them.
reports.g_company_hint: Visible to every user who has access to that information.
reports.g_system_hint: Included with the system. Make a copy to customize them.
reports.duplicated: Copy created. You can customize it now.
reports.truncated: The report has more than {{count}} rows; showing the first {{count}}. Add filters to narrow it down.
reports.d_subtitle: Choose the data, the column order, filters and how to group. The preview updates by itself.
reports.d_source_hint: Where the data comes from. Only what your role can see is listed.
reports.d_change_msg: The current columns, filters and sorting will be removed.
reports.d_vis_private_hint: Private: nobody else will see it, not even an administrator.
reports.d_vis_company_hint: Users who can see that information will see it.
reports.d_mode_detail_hint: One row per item (for example, each unit).
reports.d_mode_summary_hint: Groups rows and calculates totals: choose what to group by and what to count or add up.
reports.d_no_cols: Add columns from the field list.
reports.d_drag_hint: Drag columns to change their order.
reports.d_filters_hint: Only rows meeting all filters are included. Relative dates (last N days, this month) are recalculated every time the report is opened.
reports.d_preview_more: There are more rows: you'll see them all when running the report.
reports.d_need_agg: A summary report needs at least one calculation (count, sum…). You can add “Number of rows”.
reports.d_unavailable_msg: Some fields are no longer available.
reports.d_no_access: You don't have permission to see this report's data.

inventory_stock.name: Inventory in stock
inventory_stock.desc: Available, reserved and not-sellable units with their characteristics and location.

stock_by_type_grade.name: Stock by type and grade
stock_by_type_grade.desc: How many available units there are of each type, cosmetic grade and functional grade.

stock_by_model.name: Stock by brand and model
stock_by_model.desc: Available units grouped by type, brand and model.

stock_by_location.name: Stock by location
stock_by_location.desc: Units in stock per warehouse, area and rack.

unplaced_units.name: Units not placed
unplaced_units.desc: Units in stock that do not have a slot assigned yet.

tested_by_tech.name: Testing by technician (30 days)
tested_by_tech.desc: Units tested by each technician in the last 30 days.

lots_status.name: Lots: expected, counted and tested
lots_status.desc: Status of each lot with expected, counted, registered and available quantities.

lot_lines_detail.name: Lot lines
lot_lines_detail.desc: Detail of each lot's lines: type, brand, model and quantities.

orders_open.name: Open orders
orders_open.desc: Orders in progress with customer, seller, reservation expiry and progress.

sold_units.name: Units sold
sold_units.desc: Detail of units in completed orders, with customer and price (if you can see prices).

sales_by_customer.name: Sales by customer (quantities)
sales_by_customer.desc: Orders and units sold to each customer.

revenue_by_customer.name: Sales by customer (amounts)
revenue_by_customer.desc: Total sold to each customer. Only for those who can see prices.

slot_occupancy.name: Warehouse occupancy
slot_occupancy.desc: Capacity, used and free slots per warehouse.
